name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 55 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 3 moving objects.
